AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Bookworm
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} has always been interested in acquiring knowledge. Ever since {PAWN_pronoun} was young, {PAWN_pronoun} read every book {PAWN_pronoun} got {PAWN_possessive} hands on.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Fighter
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: Since {PAWN_nameDef} was young, {PAWN_pronoun} always liked to stand up for others and never backed down from a fight.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Leader
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} was always a leader. Whether at school or with {PAWN_possessive} friends, {PAWN_pronoun} always made the decisions and people followed {PAWN_objective}.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Artist
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: Spending most of {PAWN_possessive} time drawing, {PAWN_nameDef} developed a talent for art and crafting over the years.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Space kid
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} was born and grew up on a ship, traveling between planets and never staying long in one place. Since there weren't any children {PAWN_possessive} age on the ship, {PAWN_pronoun} acted like an adult from an early age.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Commando soldier
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: Having spent years training, {PAWN_nameDef} joined the asari fleet forces and became a commando.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Fleet scientist
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: Interstellar warfare is won by technology, so {PAWN_nameDef} dedicated years of {PAWN_possessive} life to advancing the technology of the asari fleet.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Fleet tactician
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} joined the combat division of the asari fleet. {PAWN_pronoun} turned out to have a sharp mind for battle, and became adept at commanding large armies to great effect.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Educated bodyguard
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: Hoping to change {PAWN_possessive} life, {PAWN_nameDef} left the science department and enlisted in the asari army, where {PAWN_pronoun} learned and honed {PAWN_possessive} combat skills. Later, {PAWN_pronoun} served in the personal guard of the asari fleet's officers.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Bodyguard
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} found work in the asari fleet, protecting whoever paid {PAWN_objective} from harm. {PAWN_pronoun} gained proficiency in many different combat forms, and was known for {PAWN_possessive} ruthlessness against those who crossed {PAWN_objective}.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Field medic
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} used to be a doctor at a hospital.
